audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6, First item and 2+ items all read 'Skill' while every one of the seven whys — including whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] — begins 'Vayne-favoured', and breakdown.spikes claimed you had item-spike windows on a chart that gives you none.
audit.why: The packet levelChart gives Vayne all seven stages. Silver Bolts deals a percentage of max health as true damage, so the tank build that normally rescues Mundo makes this worse rather than better as the game goes on.
audit.corrected: Vayne favoured at every stage, and the spike calendar now says you have no lane window and plays for jungle collapse instead of a duel. Submitted as one atomic chart group across content win[] and full phases[].side/.rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike was described only as 'Final Hour stealth makes her uncatchable' with no mechanism and no numbers, and phases[4]/[5]/[6].why sold them as Mundo windows.
audit.why: Final Hour is 100/85/70 and grants attack damage, invisibility during Tumble, a reduced Tumble cooldown and more Night Hunter move speed. Tumble is already 6/5/4/3/2 before that reduction — the reason you cannot hold her inside Heart Zapper's 325 range.
audit.corrected: whys[1] and whys[4] now carry the Tumble cooldown and what Final Hour actually grants; mid states the 325-range problem directly.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[2] said to 'fight in tight spaces so Condemn can't wall-stun you'. That is backwards — Condemn knocks you back and only stuns if you collide with terrain, so tight spaces are where it stuns and open ground is where it does not. Condemn's cooldown was also listed as 18s, which is its rank-2 value.
audit.why: Riot text: Vayne fires a bolt, knocking the target back; if they collide with terrain they are impaled, taking bonus damage and being stunned. Cooldown 20/18/16/14/12 — 20s at rank 1, 16s at rank 3.
audit.corrected: wants.you[2] inverted to open ground, the terrain condition stated in three places, and the cooldown corrected to 16s at rank 3 in breakdown.cooldowns and report[5].t.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[0] recommended 'tenacity/MR-agnostic tankiness'. Vayne's threat is physical damage plus max-health true damage — magic resist is irrelevant and tenacity does not touch a knockback.
audit.why: Silver Bolts is flagged trueDamage and deals a percentage of the target's max health; her other damage is physical. Armour helps against everything except the bolts, raw health helps against nothing.
audit.corrected: wants.you[0] now says armour over raw HP, and names Silver Bolts' max-health scaling as the reason.

notes: No mirror existed for this pair. The most damaging error on this page was wants.you[2] telling you to fight in TIGHT spaces to avoid Condemn's wall-stun — exactly inverted, since the stun requires terrain collision; a player following that line walks into the stun every time. Several fields across the entry use 'his/he' for Vayne (breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, report[4].t, report[9..13].t); I fixed the pronoun only where I was editing the field anyway, since a pronoun-only rewrite adds no information. Not asserted either way: whether Mundo's Goes Where He Pleases eats Condemn — the knockback-plus-terrain-stun combination is not something these files resolve, so no claim was written. Also unedited: diff reads 'EVEN' while tone is red and breakdown.difficulty says 'Hard matchup — difficulty 8/10' against a 50.71% win rate.
